item.title: NHL News: Oilers & Leafs Place Players On Waivers As Holiday Roster Freeze Lifts
item.description: As the NHL's Holiday Roster Freeze was lifted as of Sunday morning, several teams around the league have made some moves.The Edmonton Oilers have placed Noah Philp on waivers for the purpose of an assignment to AHL Bakersfield. However, with a face-off win percentage of 56.9%, and the dearth of available centers around the league, there's a chance that he could be claimed by another team, saving him a trip back to the minors.
